messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["take with a full glass of water", "with a full glass of water", "take the tablets with a full glass of water", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "take for full prescribed length of time", "take with no more than 4 ounces of plain water only", "swallow it with at least 8 ounces (a full glass) of water or other liquid", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal", "must mix powder with water", "take with food", "water", "mix tablet with 1 or 2 teaspoons of water", "squeeze liquid directly into mouth, onto spoon, or into glass of water to drink right away", "dissolve omeprazole powder in a small amount of water", "it may take 4 to 6 weeks to get the full benefit of a dose", "can take several days of regular once-daily use before full effect"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
